label: 3. Do you happen to know a Commander named Connor…

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Do you happen to know a Commander named Connor Wilson?
I don't.
There isn't any reply from Snow White for a long time...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
I see.
While searching through the ruins,
I found an ID card in the hands of a fallen Nikke.
If this Connor Wilson is still alive,
I was hoping you could return it to him for me.
I'll look it up on the intranet.
Searched for "Connor Wilson" on the Central Government intranet.
According to this, he's retired.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Then this card won't be of much use to him anymore.
I will bury it along with the fallen Nikkes.
Wouldn't it be best to return it to him anyway?
There isn't any reply from Snow White for a long time...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: To Connor Wilson? Why?
I want him to remember the Nikkes under his command.
I feel like it'd give some meaning to the Nikkes' death.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
If it is for the Nikkes' sake,
then all the more reason not to.
They paid the ultimate price to save what they wanted to protect.
And because of their sacrifice, Connor Wilson is still alive today.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
I'm more worried about how you will feel
when you find out he doesn't remember these Nikkes.
So just bury them all.
Wait.
Failed to send message.

Even if he has forgotten,
it's still his duty to remember.
Failed to send message.
Snow White seems to have entered a no-communication zone...
